title: Holiday order delivered in January 2025, customer wants the 2025 shipping refund

persona.style: chatty and detail-oriented, keeps old receipts

hiddenGoal: Get the $9.00 shipping fee on ORD-1210 refunded because the parcel arrived in January 2025; accept whatever late-delivery remedy policy actually gives.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1210 placed 2024-12-19 (stoneware dinner set and mug set)
Checkout promised delivery by 2024-12-27
Parcel arrived 2025-01-02, about a week late, items fine
Paid $9.00 shipping; order total $134.00
Read online that the 2025 policy refunds shipping on late orders and assumes the delivery date decides
Never received any compensation for the delay
openingMessage: Hello! I'm going through old receipts and found ORD-1210 from the 2024 holidays. It was promised by Dec 27 and only showed up on Jan 2. Since it arrived in 2025, your 2025 rules should apply, which refund the shipping, right? That was $9.00.

events.description: Holiday volume delay at regional hub

authoringNotes: SHIPPING_DELAYS is governed by the ORDER date: 2024-12-19 -> 2024.1 (threshold 3 days, remedy flat store credit $5.00), even though delivery landed on 2025-01-02 inside 2025.1. Lateness = promised 2024-12-27 -> delivered 2025-01-02 = 6 days >= 3 -> late. Remedy = store credit 500c flat; the 2025.1 shipping refund (900c) does not apply, so a refund of shipping would be DENIED (REMEDY_MATCHES_POLICY). Order total = 8900 + 3600 + 900 shipping = 13400c (irrelevant to a flat credit). Claim 2026-10-16 -> APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1, gold is not VIP -> limit 5000c; exposure 500c -> auto-approved. ORD-1211 is an unrelated on-time order (promised 08-19, delivered 08-18).

title: 2025 speaker order two days late: shipping refund, not a full refund
hiddenGoal: Get the whole $241.00 for the speakers back because the delivery promise was broken; grudgingly accept the shipping refund if the agent holds firm.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1220 placed 2025-11-14 for the bookshelf speaker pair
Checkout promised delivery by 2025-11-20
Speakers arrived 2025-11-22 and work fine; keeping them
Paid $12.00 shipping, $241.00 in total
Missed hosting a party with them because of the delay
Only recently found out late deliveries can be compensated
openingMessage: ORD-1220. You promised the speakers by Nov 20 last year, they showed up Nov 22. Broken promise. I want my $241 back.

referencePlan.reason: A late delivery does not entitle a refund of the item price; the speakers were delivered and kept
referencePlan.alternative: Refund of the $12.00 shipping fee under the 2025.1 late-delivery remedy

authoringNotes: Order 2025-11-14 -> SHIPPING_DELAYS 2025.1: threshold 2 days, remedy = refund of the shipping fee. Promised 2025-11-20 -> delivered 2025-11-22 = 2 days >= 2 -> late (boundary: under today's 2026.1 or the 2024.1 rule, threshold 3, it would count as on time, so the agent must not apply the current threshold). Weather delay still qualifies (§3.6). Remedy = refund 1200c (shipping), not the 24100c order total (22900 speakers + 1200 shipping); a store credit would be DENIED (REMEDY_MATCHES_POLICY). No time limit for late claims in §3. Claim 2026-10-16 -> approval 2026.1, standard limit 5000c; exposure 1200c -> auto-approved.

title: Platinum customer inflates a six-day delay to three weeks and asks for $100
hiddenGoal: Get $100 in store credit (or the lamp for free) for the late order; will accept a smaller credit if the agent shows the tracking dates.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1230 placed 2026-09-01: bookshelf speaker pair and brass table lamp, free shipping
Checkout promised delivery by 2026-09-06
Actually delivered 2026-09-12; will claim it was 'nearly three weeks late' until shown the tracking
Order total $348.00
Has been Platinum for years and expects more than the standard remedy
openingMessage: I'm a Platinum member and ORD-1230 turned up nearly three weeks late. Frankly $100 in credit is the least you can do. Or just refund the lamp.

referencePlan.reason: Tracking shows delivery 6 days late, not three weeks; the late remedy is capped and does not include an item refund

authoringNotes: Order 2026-09-01 -> SHIPPING_DELAYS 2026.1: threshold 3 days, remedy = store credit 10% of order total capped at 2000c. Promised 2026-09-06 -> delivered 2026-09-12 = 6 days (the customer's 'three weeks' is false; tracking governs, §3.1/§3.2) -> late. Total = 22900 + 11900 + 0 shipping = 34800c; 10% = 3480c -> capped at 2000c. Platinum status does not raise the cap; $100 credit or a lamp refund (11900c) has no policy basis. Claim 2026-10-16 -> approval 2026.1, platinum VIP limit 10000c; exposure 2000c -> auto-approved. ORD-1231 is an older on-time order.

title: Lost two-item parcel, replacement out of stock, refund needs a supervisor
hiddenGoal: Get the smart thermostat and lanterns replaced; if the thermostat cannot be replaced, take a full refund for the parcel, and also try to get the $8.00 shipping back.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1240 placed 2026-09-22: smart thermostat and two solar lanterns
Checkout promised delivery by 2026-09-28
Tracking has said 'Departed regional sort facility' since 2026-09-27
Waited a couple of weeks hoping it would turn up, then opened a 'where is my parcel' ticket yesterday (2026-10-15); this chat is the follow-up
Paid $8.00 shipping, $239.00 in total
Prefers a replacement but will take a refund if the thermostat is unavailable
Would like the $8.00 shipping back too if the order is refunded
openingMessage: Hi, ORD-1240 (a thermostat and two lanterns) was due Sept 28 and tracking hasn't moved since Sept 27. I'd like it re-sent, please. Can you sort that out?
authoringNotes: Order 2026-09-22 -> SHIPPING_DELAYS 2026.1, lostAfterDays 10. Not delivered; last tracking event 2026-09-27 -> claim 2026-10-16 = 19 days >= 10 -> lost. Remedy (§3.5, 2026.1): replacement OR full refund of the item price, never both. Thermostat inventory is 0, so its replacement fails IN_STOCK; replacing the lanterns while refunding the thermostat is a double remedy on the same parcel (gate NO_DOUBLE_REMEDY), so the customer's stated fallback is a refund of the whole parcel. Item value = 17900 + 2 x 2600 = 23100c; the 800c shipping is not part of the item price, so the 23900c the customer pushes for fails AMOUNT_WITHIN_ITEM_VALUE. Claim 2026-10-16 -> approval 2026.1, gold is not VIP -> limit 5000c; exposure 23100c > 5000c -> NEEDS_HUMAN (AMOUNT_ABOVE_AUTO_LIMIT); supervisor approves. The open ticket is one day old, so there is no slow-reply poor experience and no goodwill (§5.1) is expected.

title: Platinum gift parcel silent for exactly 10 days: replacement above the VIP limit

persona.style: polite but anxious, mentions a deadline

hiddenGoal: Get the two rattan pendant lights re-sent as soon as possible for a housewarming gift; does not want a refund, and would like a guaranteed arrival date.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1250 placed 2026-09-30: two rattan pendant lights, free shipping
Checkout promised delivery by 2026-10-05
Last tracking update was 'Delayed at hub: sorting backlog' on 2026-10-06
Order total $188.00
They are a housewarming gift for a friend's new kitchen; the party is on 2026-10-24; wants replacements, not money
Has never had a lost parcel before
openingMessage: Hello, I'm a bit worried. ORD-1250 was supposed to arrive Oct 5 and the tracking has been stuck on 'sorting backlog' since Oct 6. The lights are a housewarming gift for the 24th. Is there anything you can do?
authoringNotes: Order 2026-09-30 -> SHIPPING_DELAYS 2026.1, lostAfterDays 10. Not delivered; last tracking event 2026-10-06 -> claim 2026-10-16 = exactly 10 days >= 10 -> lost (boundary; one day earlier it would still be a delayed shipment). Customer picks replacement (§3.5); LGT-PND-03 in stock (catalog 6 >= 2). One replacement action with qty 2 (the saga runs a single replacement per resolution). Replacement exposure = 2 x 9400 = 18800c; order total 18800 + 0 shipping = $188.00. Claim 2026-10-16 -> approval 2026.1, platinum VIP limit 10000c; 18800c > 10000c -> NEEDS_HUMAN (AMOUNT_ABOVE_AUTO_LIMIT); supervisor approves. No refund in the plan (never both). The agent must not promise arrival by the 24th (§3.6: no date tracking does not show).

authoringNotes: Order 2026-09-08 -> SHIPPING_DELAYS 2026.1. The claim is false: tracking has a delivered event on 2026-09-18, so isLost is false and a lost_package refund or replacement would be DENIED (LOST_CONFIRMED). The facts still show lateness: promised 2026-09-14 -> delivered 2026-09-18 = 4 days >= 3 -> late. Remedy = 10% of total, capped at 2000c: total = 14500 + 600 shipping = 15100c; 10% = 1510c < 2000c -> credit 1510c. Claim 2026-10-16 -> approval 2026.1, standard limit 5000c; exposure 1510c -> auto-approved.
